paras.text: As $\sigma_1^2$ and $\sigma_2^2$ are unknown and $n_1,n_2$ are small ,therefore, test statistic to be used here is $t=\frac{(\overline{X}_1-\overline{X}_2)-(\mu_1-\mu_2)}{s_p\sqrt{\frac{1}{n_1}+\frac{1}{n_2}}}$ with $\nu=n_1+n_2-2$ d.f

u}$ یا $t\ge t_{\alpha/2,
u}$، په داسې حال کې چې $t_{\alpha/2,
u}=t_{0.01/2,\,8+10-2}=t_{0.005,(16)}=2.92$

sections.theory:
As \sigma_1^2 and \sigma_2^2 are unknown and n_1,n_2 are small ,therefore, test statistic to be used here is t=\frac{(\overline{X}_1-\overline{X}_2)-(\mu_1-\mu_2)}{s_p\sqrt{\frac{1}{n_1}+\frac{1}{n_2}}} with \nu=n_1+n_2-2 d.f

iv. Calculation:

\text{Given that } n_1=8,\ n_2=10,\ \overline{X}_1=95,\ \overline{X}_2=97,\ s_1^2=47,\ s_2^2=30

\text{Now}\quad s_p=\sqrt{\frac{(n_1-1)s_1^2+(n_2-1)s_2^2}{n_1+n_2-2}}=\sqrt{\frac{(8-1)47+(10-1)30}{8+10-2}}

=\sqrt{\frac{329+270}{16}}=6.12

\text{Hence } t=\frac{(95-97)-0}{6.12\sqrt{\frac{1}{8}+\frac{1}{10}}}=\frac{-2}{2.930}=-0.689

v. Critical region:

Reject H_0 if t\le -t_{\alpha/2,\nu} or t\ge t_{\alpha/2,\nu}, whereas t_{\alpha/2,\nu}=t_{0.01/2,\,8+10-2}=t_{0.005,(16)}=2.92

vi. Conclusion:

Our calculated value of t falls in the acceptance region, so we accept H_0.

sections.theory:
Example 7.10

The following two samples are drawn from the normally distributed population with identical but unknown variances.

Sample 1: 70 68 63 60 59 57 53 51 50 49 46 45

Sample 2: 75 72 70 50 48 43 52 50 46 45

Test the equality of means at α = 0.05 level of significance.

Solution:

i. H_0:\mu_1=\mu_2

H_1:\mu_1\neq\mu_2

ii. \alpha=0.05

iii t-test statistic to be used here is

t=\frac{(\overline{X}_1-\overline{X}_2)-(\mu_1-\mu_2)}{s_p\sqrt{\frac{1}{n_1}+\frac{1}{n_2}}} with \nu=n_1+n_2-2 degrees of freedom

(iv) Calculation:

For sample-1:

n_1=12,\ \Sigma x_1=671,\ \Sigma x_1^2=38275,\ \overline{X}_1=55.92

s_1^2=\frac{1}{n_1-1}\left[\Sigma x_1^2-\frac{(\Sigma x_1)^2}{n_1}\right]

\text{or}\ (n_1-1)s_1^2=\Sigma x_1^2-\frac{(\Sigma x_1)^2}{n_1}=38275-\frac{(671)^2}{12}=754.9167

For sample-2:

$n_2=10,\ \Sigma x_2=551,\ \Sigma x_2^2=31707,\ \overline{X}_2=55.1$

نمونہ 1: 70 68 63 60 59 57 53 51 50 49 46 45

نمونہ 2: 75 72 70 50 48 43 52 50 46 45

α = 0.05 معنویت کی سطح پر اوسطوں کی برابری کی جانچ کریں۔

حل:

H_1:\mu_1\neq\mu_2

ii. \alpha=0.05

iii یہاں استعمال ہونے والا t-جانچ کا شماریہ یہ ہے

t=\frac{(\overline{X}_1-\overline{X}_2)-(\mu_1-\mu_2)}{s_p\sqrt{\frac{1}{n_1}+\frac{1}{n_2}}} جس کے درجاتِ آزادی \nu=n_1+n_2-2 ہیں

(iv) حساب:

نمونہ-1 کے لیے:

n_1=12,\ \Sigma x_1=671,\ \Sigma x_1^2=38275,\ \overline{X}_1=55.92

s_1^2=\frac{1}{n_1-1}\left[\Sigma x_1^2-\frac{(\Sigma x_1)^2}{n_1}\right]

\text{or}\ (n_1-1)s_1^2=\Sigma x_1^2-\frac{(\Sigma x_1)^2}{n_1}=38275-\frac{(671)^2}{12}=754.9167

نمونہ-2 کے لیے:

$n_2=10,\ \Sigma x_2=551,\ \Sigma x_2^2=31707,\ \overline{X}_2=55.1$
